Senses.Explanation: Great capacity to respond, together with that capacity put fully to use. The corpus itself divides the pair: Yangshan Huiji says Baizhang received great capacity and Huangbo great function (百丈得大機，黃檗得大用). Huangbo Xiyun says that he saw Mazu Daoyi's great capacity and great function but did not know Mazu (見馬祖大機大用然且不識馬祖). Tianyin Yuanxiu turns the compound into a three-part public question—great capacity and great function, the function of great capacity, and the capacity of great function—and elsewhere says it is not on the sitting mat or Chan board. Yulin Tongxiu lists taking coarse abandon and wild disorder for great capacity and great function as an error. Guting Shanjian says it can be drawn on without exhaustion, while Poshan Haiming says the buddhas' and patriarchs' great capacity and great function are the whole body and throughout the body. These are attested descriptions, questions, and cautions concerning one paired device, not different referents.
